critique: The render convincingly reads as the Form “Left Frame” Lines preset: a dense pink/magenta field of parallel luminous strings occupies and frames the left side, leaving a clean black negative-space area on the right. Across frames 1 and 4, the deformation advances subtly while preserving the anchored left-frame composition and continuous line structure.
